# Amos Chapter 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 336v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/AMO_009_page_001.jpg

---

**9:1** I-saw [ra'iti] the-Lord [Adonai] standing [nitsav] upon the-altar [ha-mizbe'ach], and-he-said, "Strike [hakh] the-capital [ha-kaftor] so-that-the-thresholds [ha-sippim] shake [yir'ashu]; and-break-them [u-betsa'am] on-the-head [be-rosh] of-all-of-them [kullam]; and-their-remnant [acharitam] with-the-sword [ba-cherev] I-will-kill [eherog]; not one-fleeing [nas] of-them will-flee [yanus], and-not one-escaping [palit] of-them will-escape [yimmalet]."

**9:2** "If they-dig [yachtetru] to-Sheol, from-there my-hand will-take-them [tiqqachem]; and-if they-go-up [ya'alu] to-the-heavens, from-there I-will-bring-them-down [oridem]."

**9:7** "Are-you not like-the-sons of-the-Kushim [Ethiopians] to-me, O-sons of-Yisra'el?" declares YHWH. "Did-I-not bring-up [he'eleiti] Yisra'el from-the-land of-Mitsrayim, and-the-Pelishtim [Philistines] from-Kaftor [Caphtor], and-Aram from-Qir?"

**9:11** "In-that day [ba-yom ha-hu] I-will-raise-up [aqim] the-booth [sukkah] of-David [David] the-fallen [ha-nofellet], and-I-will-repair [vegadarti] their-breaches [pirtseihen], and-his-ruins [harisotav] I-will-raise-up [aqim], and-I-will-rebuild-it [u-venitihah] as-in-the-days of-old [ke-yemei olam]."

**9:13** "Behold, days [yamim] [are] coming [ba'im]," declares YHWH, "when-the-plowman [ha-choresh] will-overtake [venigash] the-reaper [ba-qotser], and-the-treader [dorekh] of-grapes the-drawer [be-moshekh] of-seed [ha-zara]; and-the-mountains [ha-harim] will-drip [vehittifu] sweet-wine [asis], and-all the-hills [ha-geva'ot] will-flow [titmogagnah]."

**9:14** "And-I-will-restore [veshavti] the-captivity [shevut] of-my-people Yisra'el, and-they-will-build [u-vanu] desolate [neshammot] cities and-inhabit [veyashevu], and-plant [venate'u] vineyards [keramim] and-drink [veshatu] their-wine [yeinam], and-make [ve'asu] gardens [gannot] and-eat [ve'akhlu] their-fruit [periyhem]."

**9:15** "And-I-will-plant-them [u-neta'tiyim] on their-land [admatum], and-they-will-not-be-uprooted [velo yinnatshu] again [od] from-upon their-land which I-have-given [natati] to-them," says YHWH your-God.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.7 — "Are you not like the Cushites to me?":** One of the most radical verses in the prophetic corpus. YHWH claims to have guided the migrations of all nations — not just Israel. The Exodus is not unique; God's providential history encompasses Philistines and Arameans too.

**v.11 — "the booth of David":** *Sukkat David ha-nofellet* — the fallen tent/booth of David. Not "palace" or "throne" but *sukkah* — the most fragile of structures. The Davidic restoration envisioned here is modest, not imperial.

**v.13-15 — Eschatological abundance:** The book that began with agricultural devastation (ch.1-4) ends with superabundance — harvests so rich they overlap, mountains dripping wine, permanent settlement. The reversal is complete.

*— EMET*
